articles.title: Messi in Argentina squad for farewell friendly
articles.summary: Argentina name Lionel Messi in their squad for a friendly against Benin in October in a match which is set to be the forward's farewell to international football.

articles.title: Glasgow, 16, makes Docherty's Scotland U21 squad
articles.summary: Sixteen-year-old Kyle Glasgow has been included in Tony Docherty's first Scotland Under-21 squad.

articles.title: The key talking points from Pocognoli's bold Scotland squad
articles.summary: The Sebastien Pocognoli Scotland era is already creating serious intrigue - and the Belgian's squad are yet to assemble for a training-ground rondo, never mind play a game.
